text_block_list.text: (Click-click-click-click-click!)

Arriving at the cafeteria one day, a huge 
crowd of horse girls had gathered. All 
their camera lenses were pointed squarely 
at Oguri Cap...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Whoa! What's all the commotion about!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, isn't Oguri-senpai just eating 
like crazy like she always does!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So why on earth are this many people 
gathered around?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo, allow me to introduce them. These 
are members of the "Watch Oguri Eat 
Association."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Umm... ...What was it again?

text_block_list.name: Watch Group Member A
text_block_list.text:
There's a superstition trending among the 
students right now. And that is...

text_block_list.name: Watch Group Member A
text_block_list.text:
"Setting a photo of Oguri-senpai eating as 
your phone wallpaper makes your diet 
succeed!" ...That's it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Huuuuh~?!

text_block_list.name: Watch Group Member B
text_block_list.text:
At first, it was just one student sharing 
how she managed to lose weight even while 
eating a lot, and apparently that was all 
thanks to Oguri-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Watching Club Member B
text_block_list.text:
Then one thing led to another... and 
people started saying that setting 
Oguri-senpai as your lock screen helps you 
lose weight!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh, is that so... Wait, no no no! 
Wouldn't just running laps be way faster?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, are you really okay with 
this, Oguri-senpai?! You're being totally 
put on display!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...If my eating brings happiness to 
everyone... I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it makes me happy. Making people 
smile feels good. But...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I love eating. But when you savor food 
together with others, that happiness 
doubles. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If I could eat together with everyone, I'd 
be even happier...

text_block_list.name: Watching Club Members
text_block_list.text: (*Heart squeeze!!*)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Guhh...!! How... how can someone have such 
a pure heart?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right then, let's eat together!! I'll 
go grab chopsticks and plates right now!

text_block_list.name: Watching Club Members
text_block_list.text:
L-Let's go get plates too...! Diets start 
tomorrow for real, 100%!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... You all will too...? I'm so 
happy...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —Well then... Let's dig in, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo & Everyone
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ain't that completely defeat the whole 
point?! Stick to your diets, dammit!
